EXIST Transfer of Research

EXIST Transfer of Research supports outstanding research-based start-up projects that require complex and risky development work.

Who is eligible?

Teams of researchers at universities and research institutions are eligible; the university or research institution must support the project through its start-up service.

The company must not yet have been founded at the time of application.

Funding phase I

Funding phase I lasts up to 18 months.

Deadlines

Project outlines can be submitted on 31 January and 31 July each year.
